title: Patch the Planet: a Daybreak initiative to support open source maintainers
summary: OpenAI introduces Patch the Planet, a Daybreak initiative helping open-source maintainers find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities with AI and expert review.
body: OpenAI introduces Patch the Planet, a Daybreak initiative helping open-source maintainers find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities with AI and expert review.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了名为Patch the Planet的Daybreak计划，旨在利用人工智能与专家评审相结合的方式，帮助开源软件维护者发现、验证并修复代码中的安全漏洞。原始信息显示：OpenAI introduces Patch the Planet, a Daybreak initiative helping open-source maintainers find, validate, and fix vulnerabilities with AI and expert review.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Patch the Planet: a Daybreak initiative to support open source maintainers”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI推出Daybreak计划Patch the Planet，利用AI和专家评审帮助开源维护者修复漏洞，对开源生态影响重大。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
